title: SIP (Systematic Investment Plan)
shortText: Invest a fixed amount every month and build wealth with discipline.
whatItIs: A SIP lets you invest a fixed amount in a mutual fund scheme on a chosen date every month. Each instalment buys units at that day's NAV, so you buy more units when prices are low and fewer when they are high. Over long periods this rupee cost averaging, together with compounding, can help you build a corpus for your goals.
whoItSuits: Salaried professionals and anyone with a regular income who wants to invest steadily for goals that are five or more years away, without trying to time the market.
howItWorks: Tell us your goal and time horizon in a free consultation
Choose a scheme whose risk-o-meter matches your risk profile
Register a one-time bank mandate (NACH / UPI AutoPay)
Your SIP is debited automatically every month; track it on your dashboard
Step up, pause or stop your SIP online whenever you need

faqs.question: What is the minimum SIP amount?
faqs.answer: Many schemes accept SIPs from Rs 500 per month; the minimum for each scheme is shown on its page.

faqs.question: Can I change my SIP amount later?
faqs.answer: You can add a new SIP, set an annual step-up or cancel and restart a SIP with a different amount.

faqs.question: Is a SIP return guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No. SIP returns depend on the scheme's performance and market movements; they are not guaranteed.
